title: RubricRefine: Improving Tool-Use Agent Reliability with Training-Free Pre-Execution Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2605.09730v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Iterative self-refinement is a popular inference-time reliability technique, but its effectiveness in code-mode tool use depends heavily on the structure of the feedback signal: unstructured critique helps inconsistently across models, and even revision with real execution feedback improves only modestly. The dominant failures are inter-tool contract violations (wrong output shape, incorrect tool routing, broken argument provenance) that run to completion without raising errors, making runtime feedback insufficient. We introduce RubricRefine, a training-free method for pre-execution contract checking that generates task- and registry-specific rubrics, scores candidate code against explicit contract checks, and iteratively repairs failures before any execution occurs. translated_title: RubricRefine：通过无需训练的执行前精炼提升工具使用智能体的可靠性
translated_abstract: 迭代式自我精炼是一种流行的推理时可靠性技术，但其在代码模式工具使用中的有效性很大程度上取决于反馈信号的结构：非结构化的批评在不同模型间的帮助效果不一致，即使使用真实执行反馈进行修订，改进也非常有限。主要的失败模式是工具间契约违规（错误的输出形状、不正确的工具路由、断裂的参数溯源），这些错误会完整运行而不引发任何错误，使得运行时反馈不足以发现问题。我们提出了RubricRefine，这是一种无需训练的执行前契约检查方法，它生成针对特定任务和工具注册表的评分标准，根据明确的契约检查对候选代码进行评分，并在任何执行发生之前迭代修复失败。RubricRefine在零执行尝试的情况下，跨七个模型在M3ToolEval上平均达到0.86，以更低的延迟超越了先前的推理时基线。
tldr: RubricRefine提出了一种无需训练的执行前契约检查方法，通过生成任务特定的评分标准、对候选代码进行契约检查评分并迭代修复失败，在零执行尝试的情况下将工具使用智能体在M3ToolEval上的平均性能提升至0.86。
en_tdlr: RubricRefine is a training-free pre-execution contract checking method that generates task-specific rubrics, scores candidate code against explicit contract checks, and iteratively repairs failures before execution, achieving 0.86 average performance on M3ToolEval across seven models with zero execution attempts.
